name: TailAdmin
author: VM Engine
description: TailAdmin-based default theme: admin (app), auth (guest) and public website (frontend) layouts with dark mode

color_scheme.primary: TailAdmin brand blue (#465fff, from synapse-components.css design tokens)
color_scheme.dark_mode: Supported via .dark class toggle (Alpine darkMode, persisted), matching synapse-components.css's @custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *))

components.sidebar: Collapsible sidebar, white (light) / near-black (dark) background, TailAdmin style
components.header: Fixed header with search and user menu
components.forms: Styled form inputs with validation states

customization.typography: Adjust font sizes and weights in @theme
customization.components: Admin styles in css/theme-app.css, public site styles in css/theme-frontend.css
customization.javascript: Shared Alpine components in js/theme-base.js, per-layout ones in js/theme-{app,guest,frontend}.js
